<!-- The supplementary figures and tables, numbered on a counter of their
     own: Figure S1, Table S1. Each is a div with the sfig- or stbl- id, the
     chunk inside it, and the legend as the last paragraph of the div. Cite
     them from anywhere in the manuscript with @sfig-... and @stbl-....
     The supplement is also rendered as a document of its own -- by
     render_docx(), render_pdf() and make_submission() -- and that document
     runs R/setup.R and this file only, not the chunks of the Methods. So it
     reads here, itself, the data its figures and tables need. -->

```{r}
#| label: suppl-data
abund    <- read.csv(here::here("data/tree_abundance.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
Y_counts <- as.matrix(abund[, -1])
species  <- colnames(Y_counts)
totals   <- sort(colSums(Y_counts), decreasing = TRUE)
n_top    <- min(30L, length(species))
# The part of a species name in italics, and the part in roman.
sp_italic <- function(x) sub("( sp\\..*| complex)$", "", x)
sp_roman  <- function(x) substring(x, nchar(sp_italic(x)) + 1L)
sp_label  <- function(x) bquote(italic(.(sp_italic(x))) * .(sp_roman(x)))
```

::: {#sfig-rankabund}

```{r}
#| label: suppl-rankabund
#| include: true
#| fig-width: 7.09
#| fig-height: 4.72
par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 1, 1), las = 1)
plot(seq_along(totals), totals, log = "y", type = "h", col = color5,
     xlab = "Species rank", ylab = "Trees (log scale)")
top5 <- names(totals)[1:5]
text(1:5 + 6, totals[1:5], labels = as.expression(lapply(top5, sp_label)),
     adj = 0, cex = 0.75, col = "grey30")
```

Rank-abundance of the tree species of the plot: the number of trees of each
species, from the most to the least abundant, with the five most abundant
named.
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

::: {#stbl-species}

```{r}
#| label: suppl-species
#| include: true
sp_tab <- data.frame(
  Species = names(totals)[seq_len(n_top)],
  Trees   = as.integer(totals[seq_len(n_top)]),
  Plots   = as.integer(colSums(Y_counts[, names(totals)[seq_len(n_top)],
                                        drop = FALSE] > 0)),
  row.names = NULL
)

# The genus and the epithet in italics, "sp. A" in roman.
flextable(sp_tab) |>
  compose(j = "Species",
          value = as_paragraph(as_i(sp_italic(sp_tab$Species)),
                               as_chunk(sp_roman(sp_tab$Species)))) |>
  align(part = "all", align = "left") |>
  hline_top(border = fp_border_default(width = 0), part = "all") |>
  hline_bottom(border = fp_border_default(style = "solid", color = "black",
                                          width = 1), part = "all") |>
  fit_flextable_to_page()
```

The most abundant tree species of the plot, with the number of trees and of
1-ha plots each was found in.
:::
